device.modelDescription: handlers that make TLS client connections (tls.connect, https, fetch), so what the lockdown lets through can be seen

actionList.name: tlsRoundTrip
actionList.description: tls.connect to 127.0.0.1:input.port, one HTTP/1.0 GET over it: 'round-trip' with authorized, or the error code.

actionList.name: httpsGet
actionList.description: https.get from 127.0.0.1:input.port: the status and body, or the error code.

actionList.name: fetchGet
actionList.description: fetch from https://127.0.0.1:input.port/: the body, or the error code.
